name: Roo Code
desc: Open-source Cline fork with mode-based agent orchestration
desc_zh: Cline 的开源分支，主打多模式（架构师/编码/调试）任务编排
solves: You want the agent to plan the change, then make it, then debug it, but one tool rarely does all three well. It switches modes for each.
solves_zh: 你希望智能体先规划改动、再动手实现、再排查问题，但一个工具通常做不好这三件事里的每件。Roo Code 为每一步切换模式。
best_for: When you want an open-source agent in VS Code that changes behaviour depending on the task.
best_for_zh: 当你想在 VS Code 里用一个开源智能体，并希望它根据任务类型切换行为时。
